rows.note: For the ordinary flat cooking-pan sense, this is the all-purpose choice among these cookware terms.

example.english: I use a pan to fry two eggs.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ping4 dai2 wok6 zin1 loeng5 zek3 daan6

rows.note: Use this for a saucepan with one long handle rather than a flat pan or a basin.

example.english: This pan is perfect for making soup.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan1 beng3 bou1 ngaam1 saai3 zyu2 tong1

rows.note: Use this for a deep household basin or wash pan, especially a plastic one.

example.english: Mum uses a pan to soak vegetables.
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 jung6 go3 pun4 zam3 coi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the receptacle used by a bedridden person as a toilet.

example.english: The patient needs a pan to use in bed, so they do not have to get up.
example.traditional: 病人要用便盆，唔使落床。
example.jyutping: beng6 jan4 jiu3 jung6 bin6 pun4 m4 sai2 lok6 cong4
